description: The FIRST disjunct of :628-629 - an ACCTSIDI holding an asterisk followed by ten spaces - and the case without which that ordered OR is only half driven. case05 is this case's pair and its only structural difference: case05 supplies eleven spaces and takes the SPACES half at :629, this one supplies the asterisk and takes the '*' half at :628, and because both halves converge on MOVE LOW-VALUES TO CC-ACCT-ID at :630 every byte downstream of that MOVE is identical. That convergence is what makes the pair legitimate rather than duplicated - the same arm reached through a different entry condition - and it is why these two files differ in exactly three places: caseId, the eleven bytes of ACCTSIDI, and this description. It is also why the case is needed at all: no other case in this folder supplies an asterisk in any field, so before this one a translation that implemented = SPACES and quietly dropped = '*' would have satisfied all twenty cases while treating an asterisk as a keyed account number and reading a record for it (gate G30, which is about the ORDER and the COMPLETENESS of an EVALUATE or a condition, not merely its outcome). THE INPUT IS AN ASTERISK PLUS TEN SPACES - NOT A BARE ASTERISK, AND NOT AN ASTERISK-FILLED FIELD. :628 compares the eleven-byte ACCTSIDI against the one-character literal '*', and a COBOL alphanumeric comparison space-pads the shorter operand up to the length of the longer, so the field equals the literal exactly when it holds '*' and then ten spaces. app/cpy-bms/COACTVW.CPY:60 declares that item PIC 99999999999 - numeric, under PICIN='99999999999' with VALIDN=(MUSTFILL) - and the program nevertheless compares it against '*' and against SPACES. That declaration mismatch is the program's own and is preserved rather than repaired (practice B5); it is precisely why the Java DTO carries the item as an eleven-character String instead of a number, and why AccountViewController.isAsteriskOrSpaces moves both operands through the PIC X codec before comparing them, so the padding rule is reproduced rather than assumed. The control path is case05's exactly. EIBCALEN is 172 and CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM is COCRDLIC rather than LIT-MENUPGM, so the guard at :282-284 takes its ELSE and :288-292 splits the 172-byte DFHCOMMAREA into CARDDEMO-COMMAREA and WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA - the 160 bytes of app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy:21-44 plus the twelve of :213-216. EIBAID is DFHENTER, so YYYY-STORE-PFKEY takes its first arm (COPY 'CSSTRPFY' at :913) and the PF-key gate at :306-314 finds CCARD-AID-ENTER already valid and leaves it alone. The main EVALUATE TRUE at :323-383 is order-sensitive - PFK03 at :324, PGM-ENTER at :353, PGM-REENTER at :361, WHEN OTHER at :375 - and this case takes the third arm, where 2000-PROCESS-INPUTS runs at :362-363 and IF INPUT-ERROR at :364 is true, so 1000-SEND-MAP runs at :365-366 and :367 leaves through GO TO COMMON-RETURN. That GO TO is a forward-only early exit restructured to a plain return (rule R7), and it is why the trailing IF INPUT-ERROR guard at :387-392 is bypassed and the map is sent ONCE rather than twice - the send count is itself behaviour, which is why sends is a list and why this case pins exactly one. It is equally why 9000-READ-ACCT at :369-370 never runs: NO DATASET IS READ ON THIS PATH, which is an assertion in its own right rather than an omission. Gates G45 and G47 are therefore NOT EXERCISED here - there is no read site at which to drive an alternate-index finder or a FileStatus outcome - and no read is invented in order to reach them; case03 drives all three sites at NORMAL and case09 onward drive NOTFND and WHEN OTHER. 2200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS at :622-643 sets INPUT-OK at :624 and FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID at :625, then takes the asterisk half of :628 and moves LOW-VALUES into CC-ACCT-ID at :630. 2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT at :649-681 sets FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK first at :650, and then its not-supplied guard at :653-662 is true - CC-ACCT-ID is LOW-VALUES, which is what :630 just put there, so the asterisk never reaches this test as an asterisk: INPUT-ERROR at :655, FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK at :656, WS-PROMPT-FOR-ACCT at :658 under the WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF test at :657, MOVE ZEROES TO CDEMO-ACCT-ID at :660, and GO TO 2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT-EXIT at :661. Because :661 leaves first, the not-numeric-or-zeroes guard at :666-676 is SKIPPED and the flag ends BLANK rather than NOT-OK - which is the whole reason the marker at :561-565 fires here and does not fire for a badly-formed filter. THE MESSAGE IS SET TWICE AND THE SECOND VALUE WINS, WHICH IS NOT A MISTAKE IN THIS EXPECTATION. Control returns to 2200, whose cross-field edit at :639-642 finds FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK and performs SET NO-SEARCH-CRITERIA-RECEIVED TO TRUE at :641. WS-PROMPT-FOR-ACCT and NO-SEARCH-CRITERIA-RECEIVED are both 88-levels on the SAME WS-RETURN-MSG PIC X(75) declared at :117 - 'Account number not provided' at :121-122 and 'No input received' at :123-124 - so :641 overwrites what :658 had just put there. ERRMSGO therefore reads 'No input received' and NOT 'Account number not provided': seventeen characters, space-padded to the 75 of WS-RETURN-MSG and then to the 78 of app/cpy-bms/COACTVW.CPY:464 by the MOVE at :532, and 78 is the width emitted here. The overwrite is preserved rather than corrected back (practice B5). 1100-SCREEN-INIT at :431-455 group-moves LOW-VALUES over the whole CACTVWAO area at :432 and then sets only the six header items, so every field this path does not touch stays LOW-VALUES - including the five PIC +ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ.99 money receivers declared at app/cpy-bms/COACTVW.CPY:302, :314, :326, :332 and :344, which are fifteen bytes of x'00' each rather than an edited '+           .00' precisely because no read populated them. 1200-SETUP-SCREEN-VARS at :460-535 takes its ELSE at :464 because EIBCALEN is 172, and inside it FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK sends it to :466, which moves LOW-VALUES into ACCTSIDO; FOUND-ACCT-IN-MASTER and FOUND-CUST-IN-MASTER are both false, so the ten account items at :471-491 and the seventeen customer items at :493-523 are never projected. WS-INFO-MSG was never set on this path, so the guard at :528-530 fires and INFOMSGO carries 'Enter or update id of account to display' from :113-114 - FORTY characters, which fill WS-INFO-MSG PIC X(40) at :110 exactly with no pad of their own before the MOVE at :534 extends them to the 45 of COACTVW.CPY:458, and 45 is the width emitted here. That same info message is why :567-571 takes its ELSE and colours INFOMSGC DFHNEUTR rather than DFHBMDAR. 1300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS at :541-572 is the gate G38 site and this case is its positive half. It moves DFHBMFSE into ACCTSIDA of the INPUT map at :543, which is metadata and not payload; it positions the cursor through an EVALUATE at :546-552 whose arms at :547 and :548 have bodies identical to its WHEN OTHER at :550-551, all three moving -1 into ACCTSIDL, and that duplication is preserved rather than collapsed (practice B5); it sets ACCTSIDC to DFHDFCOL at :555; it does NOT take :557-559, because 2210 left the flag BLANK and not NOT-OK; and it then takes :561-565, where MOVE '*' TO ACCTSIDO at :563 overwrites the LOW-VALUES :466 had left and MOVE DFHRED TO ACCTSIDC at :564 colours the field. Both halves of the AND at :561-562 hold - the field is BLANK and the context is REENTER - and case01 and case02 are the negative half of the gate: they present an equally blank filter with CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT 0, where :561-565 does not fire and ACCTSIDO stays LOW-VALUES under DFHDFCOL, so the flag alone cannot be what distinguishes them and a translation that dropped the context half of the AND would mark a field at a user who had not yet typed anything. A COINCIDENCE WORTH NAMING, SO THAT NOBODY READS THE OUTPUT AS AN ECHO OF THE INPUT: this case supplies an asterisk and this case's ACCTSIDO comes back an asterisk, but the two are unrelated. The input asterisk was consumed at :630, where it became LOW-VALUES and ceased to exist; the output asterisk is a fresh literal written by :563 because the filter ended BLANK and the context is REENTER. Nothing carries the typed byte through to the screen - case05 proves it, since it types eleven spaces and its ACCTSIDO is the same asterisk. The round trip is coincidental, not causal. ACCTSIDO is consequently an asterisk followed by TEN SPACES rather than an asterisk followed by LOW-VALUES: a COBOL MOVE of a one-character literal into the PIC X(11) receiver at COACTVW.CPY:284 space-pads the remaining ten bytes. COACTVWC does not COPY CSSETATY - the highlight is inline here - and the Java form routes it through common/FieldAttributeSetter, which applies BmsAttributes.DFHRED when the flag is NOT-OK or BLANK and the context is REENTER, and the asterisk only when the flag is BLANK, taking the re-entry state as an explicit boolean parameter so the context half of the AND cannot be dropped. DFHRED, DFHDFCOL, DFHNEUTR and DFHDFHI are reproduced in common/BmsAttributes from IBM CICS documentation because DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR are IBM-supplied and absent from this repository (risk R-D). 1400-SEND-SCREEN at :577-591 names COACTVW at :579 and CACTVWA at :580 and sets CDEMO-PGM-REENTER at :581, so the returned context is 1; :602 names COACTVWC as the next program, and because a map was sent the turn is a RETURN_TRANSID rather than an XCTL. CDEMO-ACCT-ID comes back ZEROES from :660, and CDEMO-CUST-ID, CDEMO-CARD-NUM and the three name fields keep what INITIALIZE left at :268-270 because no read ran - all sixteen commarea fields travel in the payload and none on the server (gate G37, rule R6), and the unit is reached as a plain constructor-injected object with no MockMvc, no servlet container and no HTTP in the path (gate G51). COACTVWC issues no WRITE, REWRITE or DELETE, so the write channel is EMPTY as a positive assertion rather than an absence of interest, and all five seeded rows are pinned unchanged on the final-state channel, each one field by field and again as a whole record image so that the 50-, 300- and 500-byte widths and their space-filled FILLER spans are both asserted (gates G19 and G21). Gates G35 and G32 are not applicable: COACTVWC contains no CALL 'CEE3ABD' and no backward GO TO. Statically derived and never captured from a live COBOL execution (risk R-A): every expected value comes from app/cbl/COACTVWC.cbl, the xxxI and xxxO PICTURE clauses of app/cpy-bms/COACTVW.CPY, the byte offsets of app/cpy/CVACT03Y.cpy, app/cpy/CVACT01Y.cpy and app/cpy/CVCUS01Y.cpy, the titles at app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy:19 and the active :22 - :21 is commented out - and the real fixture rows, cardxref.txt 0-based rows 0 to 2 at their unpadded 36 bytes normalised to the 50 CVACT03Y declares, acctdata.txt 0-based row 49 and custdata.txt 0-based row 49. The clock is pinned at 2022-07-19T23:15:58, the instant the source's own version footer at app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy:26 records, so the two FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE reads at :434 and :441 are reproducible (practice B7).
